description: Resolves the authoritative scope for a request. Returns the deepest `.ai/instruct.md` covering the affected path(s) plus any governance refs registered for that scope. Used by the Router agent to decide where to delegate.
checklist: 1. Parse the request: extract affected_paths (file or directory paths), topic keywords, and the action verb

2. For each affected path, walk upward from that path to the workspace root and collect every `.ai/instruct.md` encountered — the deepest is the scope authority; shallower entries are background context
3. If no affected path is given, attempt topic-to-path resolution via `.ai/index.md`; if still ambiguous, ask the user before routing
4. Call `get-governance-rules` with the resolved scope_path and topic to attach any policy/regulation refs (may be empty)

5. Pick the next-hop agent: `supervisor` for multi-step generative work, a single worker (scaffolder|generator|validator|tester|reviewer) for a single-step task, or `project-explorer` for read-only exploration
6. Emit a routing decision: { scope_path, scope_authority_file, background_files, governance_refs, next_hop, original_task }
7. Call `log-action` to record the routing decision
